title: Native Algorithm Rest Adapter
description: Add nativeAlgorithmAdapter.ts in semio/algorithms calling REST for python/go/rust and @semio/js for ts; wire Storybook language decorator and engine FastAPI routes end-to-end.
summary: Enforced that semio language bundles are pure libraries (no bridge code). Removed bridge/REST/CLI glue from semio/go (deleted cmd/nativebridge), semio/rs (removed native_bridge bin + deleted src/bin/native_bridge.rs), semio/net (removed --native-bridge from Semio.Benchmark), and semio/py (removed Native Algorithms Rest server). Implemented Storybook-only native algorithm proxy in semio/algorithms that dispatches to ticket-local Go/Rust/C# bridge programs under the ticket folder and calls Python library functions via uv-run, keeping bridging out of the language implementations.
